strings.subtitle: — Mufuishi wa mifidi —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kukoka ne kuleka ke biakudimu. Longolola lubaya lwa panshi.
strings.shred_button: F U I S H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Dilongolola! Mu SSD, mbila wa kufunda patoka kewakanyisha kufuisha mu mhamba wa TRIM.
Ndonga eyi idi ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Mufidi "{name}" ukufundibwa patoka ne kufuibwa.

Kulonda?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mishiku ya malu yambulwa (ADS) ke musalayi wa kufunda.
• Mukanda wa USN ke wakudimu.
• Bifwatulu bwa mudidi ne bikwata bwenge
  (OneDrive ne bionso) ke bikutshikisa.
strings.step_delete: Kufuisha kupita ku mbemba ya mvunvu
strings.status_full: Malu onso afundibwe patoka ne zeru. Kudilula kena kumueneka — bingidi bwa kubala bikamona zeru bua.
strings.status_fast: Mutwe, mukila ne 4 MB mishiku ifundibwe patoka. Bimwe ke bitSHIKA, mbwenu mu mhamba wa mpunga, kudilula kwonso ne bingidi bwa balombi ke kumueneka. Mu mikanda ya nkuku, longolola mudimu WA MBUMBU.
strings.status_empty: Mufidi wadi tshibenda, kufunda patoka ke kwakudimu. Wafuibwe.
strings.error_permission: Ke na kulua mufidi. Waba wavuluka mu ndonga imwe. Vula ne ufwele mutshima.
strings.error_is_symlink: Etshi tshikwata tsha kifwatulu. Bikwata ke na kufuishibwa — mufidi wa kulomba ukashala wabidi.
strings.error_reparse: Etshi mufidi wa malo (OneDrive nansha tshimwe). Malu aye ke mu bwenge, ke mu disiki to — nansha tshimwa tsha kufuisha.
strings.error_not_file: Etshi ke mufidi to (folda nansha tshimwe). Leka mufidi.
strings.error_hardlinks: Uyu mufidi una bikwata bwa nkukuta bimwe ({n} bionso). Bikwata bwa nkukuta ke na mukalenge to — madîna onso alingana. Suku ufuisha mu nzhila ya lelu, malu akafundibwa patoka ne kuteta ne 32 byte, mbwenu ekashala kikamona mu bikwata bimwe. Fuisha bikwata bionso patoka.
strings.error_compressed:
Mufidi ukoleshibwe, ufutululwe nansha mutshi. Kufunda patoka ne zeru ke kwakanyisha kufuisha malu a kala mhamba NTFS waya muaba wa mbwelwa.

Tshimuna tshilembi: finya pa lubambala lwa lumu → Milembi → Lumu luba → tshimuna tshikolesha tshia "Kukolesha" ne/nansha "Kufutulula". Nansha nansha longolola SHREDDER kabidi.
